def: An open-source structured-generation engine that compiles JSON Schemas and context-free grammars into byte-level pushdown automata and precomputes masks for context-independent tokens, keeping constrained decoding fast.
practice: Its README calls it the default structured-generation backend of most inference engines, including vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM and MLC-LLM (as of November 2026).
